name: Systango Technologies Ltd.
summary: Systango Technologies Ltd. is a digital engineering company that provides a comprehensive range of IT and product engineering services to diverse organizations globally. Its primary services include custom software development, web and mobile application development, cloud engineering and cloud-native solutions, and data engineering. The company specializes in emerging technologies, offering solutions in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Web3 and Blockchain development. Additionally, Systango provides DevOps services, quality assurance, UI/UX design, digital marketing, and managed services. Systango Technologies targets various clients, from high-growth startups and small to medium enterprises to larger corporations, across industries such as FinTech, Hospitality, Healthcare, Entertainment, SaaS, E-commerce, and Social Media. The company operates with a global delivery model, serving international markets, particularly the UK and USA, with its main development center in India and a presence in the UK, USA, Singapore, and UAE.
